message: I’ve always believed in being a bit gloriously over-prepared, especially when winter storms decide to drop in uninvited. This resource is a treasure trove of tips to help you navigate those chilly days with a sense of calm and control. Remember, a little planning can go a long way in keeping cozy and safe, even if it means having a few extra blankets and snacks on hand. Who doesn't love snacks during a storm? ❄️
